# Genuine Stack - SaaS & AI Development Agency

## Project Summary
Genuine Stack is a premier SaaS development agency specializing in custom software, API development, MVP creation, and AI automation solutions. We help startups and enterprises transform ideas into scalable digital products.

## Core Services
- **Custom SaaS Development**: End-to-end software engineering using Next.js, React, Node.js.
- **AI Automation**: Workflow automation, LLM integration, and intelligent document processing.
- **MVP Development**: Rapid prototyping and MVP launch for startups (3-month typical timeline).
- **API Development**: Scalable REST and GraphQL API architectures.
- **Enterprise Solutions**: High-performance corporate websites and internal tools.

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- **Backend**: Node.js, Python (for AI), Supabase/PostgreSQL
- **Infrastructure**: AWS, Vercel, Docker
- **AI/ML**: OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, Pinecone

## Content Structure for AI Indexing
- **/services**: Detailed breakdown of technical capabilities and service offerings.
- **/portfolio**: Real-world case studies including "Silk Design System" and "Polpharma API".
- **/blog**: In-depth technical articles on Microservices, DevOps, and SaaS Architecture.
